sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Kameshwar Mishra
Respondent :- The State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Atipriya Gautam,Madhaw Pandey,Sr. Advocate,Vinod Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ajit Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State.

2.  The petitioner has approached this Court for a direction to quash the departmental proceedings as was drawn against him in connection with a criminal case registered as Case Crime No.- 0215 of 2023 under Sections 419, 420, 120-B of I.P.C., Section 66/66C of Information Technology Act &
Section 29 of Police Act and Section 7, 8, 13 of Prevention of Corruption Act.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has relied upon an interim order passed in identical set of facts in Writ - A No.- 5962 of 2022 in which further proceedings pursuant to the chargesheet has been Kameshwar Mishra vs The State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190054251/
1 stayed.

entities.text: Kameshwar Mishra vs The State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He has further relied upon Paragraph Nos. 489 and 492 of the Uttar Pradesh Police Regulations.

4. Paragraph no.489 of the Regulation permits the departmental trial of police officer under Section 7 of the Police Act in certain circumstances enumerated therein whereas Paragraph no.492 shows that no final order shall be passed in the departmental proceedings.
Joint readings of the two provisions raises a question as to whether the departmental proceedings can be stayed absolutely moreso in the light of the Government Order dated 01.07.1973.
5. Learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents is granted four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, shall be filed within two weeks thereafter.

6. Connect this case with Writ A No. 14752 of 2023 and list on the date fixed in the said case.
7.

In the meanwhile until further orders of this Court, while departmental proceedings pursuant to the chargesheet dated 12th October, 2023 shall continue and petitioner shall be participating in the case but no final order shall be passed without leave of this Court.

Order Date :- 19.10.2023 Atmesh  Kameshwar Mishra vs The State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190054251/
